question: Should OpenClaw adopt purpose-specific memory role slots and per-agent memory role overrides as the public plugin/config contract for this issue?
rationale: The requested fix changes the plugin API and config surface rather than repairing a narrow regression, and VISION.md both welcomes plugin API design discussions when plugins cannot express a capability yet and says memory currently has one special slot with a planned default path.

options.title: Approve role-slot contract
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 or a maintainer-shaped successor as the implementation path after resolving conflicts and upgrade proof expectations.

options.title: Narrow to coexistence hooks
options.body: Keep the single memory slot and solve only the confirmed dreaming/Honcho coexistence gaps through smaller plugin APIs or diagnostics changes.

options.title: Keep single-slot policy
options.body: Close or defer role-slot architecture and document the supported single-slot memory model plus plugin-specific workaround guidance.

recommendation.title: Approve role-slot contract
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 or a maintainer-shaped successor as the implementation path after resolving conflicts and upgrade proof expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available owner signal from the memory-slot introduction and recent plugin/runtime config history.
